verdict.rationale: iTerm2's first-party Python package lets developers write scripts that control iTerm2 and extend its behavior: custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or entirely new features. It also has AppleScript support. Community hands-on reports praise the Python API, including a user script that switches themes with the system appearance. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party detail in the pack on the plugin lifecycle, distribution, and API reference.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extend the terminal with scripts or plugins in a real language (Lua, Python, kittens) beyond built-in options

citations.quote: iTerm2 offers a Python package which makes it easy to write Python scripts that control iTerm2 and extend its behavior.
Python Scripting API - Full automation and customization via Python. Create custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or entirely new features.
Python scripting API: basically AppleScript for iTerm except it lets you touch pretty much everything and it's not soul-crushing to write.
